glossary.FirstMeasure: Property measurement/report service brand; do not translate.
glossary.organization/company: The customer business account, not an individual user.
glossary.report: A property measurement deliverable, usually roof or exterior measurements; other namespaces may use report for analytics.
glossary.roof pitch: The slope or steepness of a roof, not a sales pitch.
glossary.credit: In FirstMeasure billing, prepaid account value spent on reports, not lending or academic credit.
glossary.order: In report checkout, a purchased report request. In sorting controls it can mean sequence; use per-message context.
glossary.scope: In construction documents, the description of work to perform.
glossary.branch: An organizational subdivision or office, unless a technical context explicitly says otherwise.
glossary.channel: A group messaging conversation in communications features.
glossary.issued document: A finalized document whose language and measurements are frozen at issue time.
glossary.roofing square: Roof-area unit equal to 100 square feet (9.290304 square metres), not a geometric square; do not convert values.
glossary.facet: One plane or face of a roof or building surface.
glossary.eave: Lower roof edge along which water drains, often carrying a gutter.
glossary.rake: Sloping roof edge at a gable, not a garden tool.
glossary.ridge / hip / valley: Roof intersection edges: top crest / outward sloping intersection / inward water-draining intersection.
glossary.flashing: Weatherproof sheet-metal detail at roof intersections, edges or penetrations.
glossary.waste allowance: Additional material percentage used in estimating, not a measurement error.
